sources.title: Granite 4.2 | IBM Granite
sources.snippet: Granite 4.2 is a family of dense reasoning language models available in three sizes: 3B, 8B, and 30B parameters. Granite 4.2 introduces native reasoning (thinking) capabilities, allowing models to perform step-by-step chain-of-thought reasoning before producing final answers.
